title: MedNiaz
subtitle: Emergency Blood Donation Coordination Platform
description: A responsive Persian RTL blood donation platform connecting donors with medical centers during emergencies. Features role-based workflows, API-driven blood requests, geographic search, donation reservations and request management.

title: BatBooks
subtitle: Social Reading & Writing Platform
description: A responsive frontend for a collaborative reading and writing platform. Built with reusable components for book listings, profiles and comments, a mobile-first layout, and REST API integration.

title: TF-IDF Text Search Engine
subtitle: Relevance-Ranked Document Search
description: A search engine that ranks text documents by relevance using the TF-IDF algorithm. Uses NLTK for preprocessing — tokenization, stopword removal and stemming — and Scikit-learn for vectorization and similarity scoring.

title: CodeBlog
subtitle: Persian RTL Blogging Platform
description: A responsive Persian RTL blogging platform built with React and Vite. It fetches article data from a remote API and provides article discovery through featured posts, categories, search and dedicated article pages, alongside dark mode and web push notification support.
